svg.desc: Choose mode & scope — Scope Review / Targeted (default) / Inventory — Scope and allowed actions; Bind inputs — Objects, layers, samples — Identity and provenance; Check prerequisites — Relevant modality only — What was verified; Classify readiness — Ready / Conditional / Blocked / Not Applicable — Next safe action
